name: Canada

nationalGame.name: Lacrosse & Ice Hockey
nationalGame.about: Lacrosse for summer, ice hockey for winter — Canada's two official national sports.
nationalGame.note: Canada is the only country with two official national sports.

loved.name: Ice Hockey
loved.why: Kids skate to school and play hockey on frozen ponds.

loved.name: Lacrosse
loved.why: First played by Indigenous peoples hundreds of years ago.

loved.name: Basketball
loved.why: Basketball was invented by a Canadian!

fact: Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world combined — and in winter many of them freeze into hockey rinks.
